## Body

PRD 009 req-05 (the pods page) merged as #354 (main 9f625486); PRD 009 is complete. Lessons from the review (B354-R1-01..03):
- Document what the CLI text renderer prints (crates/cli/src/pod.rs render), not what the daemon answers (docs/how/pij-rs-api.md). Plain text drops fields such as model, stages, log and state; say `--json` gives the full view.
- Check unfiltered list semantics in the shim: `pij sessions --history` without --seat skips closed (tombstoned) seats.
- Seat-launching examples must say `pij-rs spawn`, never `pij spawn`: the shim refuses spawn with E-RS-UNPORTED.
- `pij docs` pages are compiled into the binary, so the deployed binary can't show a new page before the deploy. Live proof = the deployed refusal plus this branch's debug build output.
- Scrub /Users/<name> paths from pasted proofs, because the repo is public.
- ddocs set/add writes compact JSON; run biome format and then ddocs build, or harness lint fails.
